items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I formed a big band and Lee did a recording with us... We knew each other from Philly and then got to be friends and musical companions.

ctx.x: That’s just like my sister and I called Cal Massey “Folks” and him and John and everybody called him Cal. Lee Morgan was also very close to him.
Lee, that’s right, Lee grew up there as well.
So he was a childhood friend as well, or at least an associate?
